cover.title: cyber resilience act

inner.title: the 24h warning
inner.body: since 11 september 2026, manufacturers must send an early warning within 24 hours of spotting an actively exploited vulnerability. the clock starts at awareness.
inner.label: clock's running

inner.title: your saas loophole
inner.body: the cra skips websites that don't support a product, but cloud features built to run one are in scope. pure saas lands in nis2 once you're medium-sized.
inner.label: not a loophole

inner.title: the sbom
inner.body: the cra expects you to document every component in your product, including an sbom. you don't have to publish it, just know what's in there.
inner.label: npm says hi

inner.title: the support end date
inner.body: buyers must see the month and year your security support ends, right at purchase. as long as we can is no longer a support period.
inner.label: pick a date

inner.title: the €15m line
inner.body: breaking the essential requirements or reporting duties can cost €15m or 2.5% of worldwide turnover. small firms are only spared for missing the 24h deadline.
inner.label: €15m fine

closer.HEADLINE:
it's not paperwork.
it's product.
